national_news.title: India Aims to Expand Exports to China and ASEAN Region
bullets: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced India's goal to become a major exporter to China and ASEAN countries during an official visit to the Netherlands.
Bilateral trade between India and China rose by nearly 29% to $91.76 billion during April-September, making China India's largest trading partner in the first half of the fiscal year.
India emphasized commitment to free and fair trade, reciprocal market access, and addressing trade challenges including China's export controls on tunnel boring machines.

national_news.title: India and Liechtenstein Review Bilateral Relations and EFTA Trade Agreement
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a bilateral meeting with Prince Alois, Acting Head of State of the Principality of Liechtenstein, in New Delhi to discuss cooperation in trade, technology, and innovation.
The leaders reviewed the implementation of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA), which entered into force last year.
The visit aimed to boost bilateral investment and build economic partnerships following the operationalization of the broader EFTA trade framework.

national_news.title: 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum Concludes in New Delhi
bullets: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum concluded in New Delhi with the unanimous adoption of a Joint Declaration focused on Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation, and Sustainability.
Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla chaired the forum under the theme 'Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development' and officially handed over the Chairship for 2027 to China.
The declaration reaffirmed commitments to the UN Charter principles, ethical Artificial Intelligence governance, counter-terrorism, and advancing the priorities of the Global South.

national_news.title: India and Liechtenstein Hold Bilateral Talks in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with the Acting Head of State of Liechtenstein, Hereditary Prince Alois, in New Delhi to enhance bilateral cooperation.
Key discussions focused on expanding trade, investment, science, technology, and innovation following the operationalization of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA).
This marks the second visit of Prince Alois to India in 2026, reinforcing economic and diplomatic engagement between the two nations.

national_news.title: Election Commission Defends Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Supreme Court
bullets: The Election Commission of India (ECI) filed a 248-page affidavit in the Supreme Court defending the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls under Article 324 of the Constitution.
The ECI clarified before a bench led by CJI Surya Kant that statutory Form 6 for voter registration was not altered and that all SIR orders were passed unanimously by all three commission members.
The affidavit affirmed Constitutional protection under Article 324(5) for the Chief Election Commissioner and urged the court to dismiss petitions relying on unverified news reports.
national_news.exam_tag: Indian Polity / Election Commission of India

national_news.title: PM Inaugurates Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave (ESTIC 2026)
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the three-day ESTIC 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.
The conclave covers 12 thematic areas including AI, biotechnology, advanced materials, healthcare, energy, and ocean sciences.
Introduced the Global Connect Networking Event bringing together over 300 participants to boost international research partnerships and industry-academia ties.

national_news.title: 9th Hero Hockey Men’s Asian Champions Trophy 2026 Begins in Punjab
bullets: The 9th edition of the Hero Hockey Men's Asian Champions Trophy 2026 kicked off at the Olympian Surjit Hockey Stadium in Jalandhar.
Six top Asian hockey nations—India, Malaysia, China, Japan, South Korea, and Bangladesh—are competing in the tournament.
Matches are scheduled at renovated venues in Jalandhar and Mohali, with the final slated for November 5 at Mohali.

national_news.title: 33rd Edition of India-Singapore Maritime Exercise (SIMBEX-2026) Concludes
bullets: The 33rd Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX-2026) hosted by the Indian Navy concluded at Visakhapatnam and the Bay of Bengal.
The bilateral exercise involved two phases: Harbour Phase for professional exchanges and Sea Phase focusing on Anti-Submarine, Anti-Air, and Anti-Surface Warfare drills.
Indian Navy deployed stealth frigate INS Nilgiri, ASW corvette INS Kamorta, P-8I, and MH-60R helicopters alongside Singapore Navy's frigate RSS Supreme.

national_news.title: MoRTH Introduces Concessional Annual Local Pass for National Highway Toll Plazas
bullets: The Ministry of Road Transport & Highways announced a 'Concessional Local Pass' for eligible non-commercial vehicle owners residing within 20 km of a National Highway fee plaza, effective November 1, 2026.
The annual pass is priced at Rs. 1,500 for fee plazas located outside municipal or local town limits and Rs. 3,000 for those situated within municipal limits.

Notified under the National Highways Fee (Determination of Rates and Collection) (Fifth Amendment) Rules, 2026, framed under the National Highways Act, 1956, the pass will also be accessible via the Rajmargyatra App starting December 1, 2026.

national_news.title: India to Amend National Anti-Doping Act to Introduce Criminal Provisions
bullets: Union Minister of Youth Affairs & Sports Mansukh Mandaviya announced upcoming amendments to the National Anti-Doping Act to introduce criminal provisions targeting doping violations, coaches, and supply chain stakeholders.
The announcement was made while chairing the COP10 Bureau meeting under the UNESCO International Convention against Doping in Sport in New Delhi.
India will sign an MoU with UNESCO to introduce the 'Sport Values in Every Classroom Toolkit' to integrate sports integrity and ethics into school curricula.

national_news.title: Ministry of Social Justice to Organize Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 in New Delhi
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment is organizing Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 at Dilli Haat, New Delhi, from November 1 to 15, themed 'Prakash aur Parampara – Jyoti se Jyoti Jalayen'.
For the first time, the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment and Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities are jointly hosting Shilp Utsav under Bharat TULIP and Purple Fest.

Bharat TULIP (Traditional Artisans' Upliftment Livelihood Programme) supports artisans through e-commerce marketing, while Purple Fest promotes inclusion and participation for persons with disabilities.

national_news.title: Department of Telecommunications records notable achievements under Special Campaign 6.0
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) under the Ministry of Communications achieved key targets in public grievance redressal, revenue generation, and space management during Special Campaign 6.
Resolved 2,270 public grievances and disposed of all 640 pending public grievance appeals.
Generated revenue of ₹2.08 crore from scrap disposal and ₹2.18 crore from e-waste disposal, while freeing 80,724 square feet of office space across 520 campaign sites.

national_news.title: DAC Approves Defense Capital Acquisition Proposals Worth ₹2.12 Lakh Crore
bullets: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, cleared capital acquisition proposals for the Armed Forces estimated at around ₹2.12 lakh crore.
Approximately 82% of the approved procurements will be sourced from the Indian defense industry to enhance indigenous manufacturing.

Major approvals include High Mobility Vehicles, Light Multi Role Helicopters, Long Range Kamikaze Drone Systems, VSHORADS, Active Offboard Decoy Systems for the Navy, and Mobile X-Band Doppler Weather Radars for the Air Force.

national_news.title: Commerce Ministry Extends RELIEF Scheme for Exporters to March 2027
bullets: The Department of Commerce extended Component II of the Resilience and Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation (RELIEF) scheme under the Export Promotion Mission until March 31, 2027.

The scheme provides 95% risk coverage through the Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India (ECGC) for export shipments navigating geopolitical disruptions and maritime logistics risks in West Asia and the Gulf region.

Eligible cargo categories include Full Container Load (FCL), Less than Container Load (LCL), and refrigerated containers, while protecting exporter premium rates against surge hikes beyond pre-disruption levels.

national_news.title: ISRO Announces Expansion with Four Functional Launch Pads by 2029
bullets: ISRO Chairman V Narayanan announced that India will have four functional launch pads by 2029 to meet global satellite launch demands.
Plans include a 2,000-acre dedicated Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV) complex at Kulasekarapattinam in Tamil Nadu's Tuticorin district and a third launch pad at Sriharikota.

ISRO plans to conduct the first uncrewed Gaganyaan test within two months, followed by two more uncrewed tests before the crewed mission, alongside a collaborative lunar mission Chandrayaan-5 with Japan.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Emphasizes Zero Tolerance for Terrorism and Calls for Reformed Multilateralism
bullets: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar stated that terrorism as an instrument of statecraft is unacceptable and cannot be justified or rationalised.
Highlighted the Global South's '4F' crisis encompassing finance, fuel, food, and fertiliser, urging the Global North to share equal responsibility.
Reiterated India's stance that dialogue and diplomacy are the sole solutions to global conflicts like Ukraine and West Asia, and called for reformed multilateralism at the United Nations.

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates RBI's Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
Highlighted major financial inclusion milestones including nearly 60 crore Jan Dhan accounts and credit expansion via Mudra Yojana and PM SVANidhi.
Emphasized the critical role of modern computing infrastructure and specialized cybersecurity training in protecting India's expanding digital financial system from cyber threats.

national_news.title: GeM Promotes 'The AABHAR Collection' to Showcase India's Cultural Heritage and Support Local Artisans
bullets: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is promoting 'The AABHAR Collection', a dedicated digital storefront featuring 294 product listings from 10 State and Central Handloom and Handicraft Emporiums.
Integrates products associated with the One District, One Product (ODOP) initiative and Geographical Indication (GI) tags into public procurement.
Aims to provide effective market linkages for artisans, weavers, rural entrepreneurs, and women-led enterprises for government gifting requirements.

national_news.title: Union Health Ministry Observes Vigilance Awareness Week 2026
bullets: The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare observed Vigilance Awareness Week 2026 with an Integrity Pledge-taking ceremony administered by Union Health Minister JP Nadda in New Delhi.
Observed from October 26 to November 1, 2026, coinciding with the birth anniversary week of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
The theme for the 2026 observance is 'Probity for Prosperity', emphasizing honesty, transparency, and ethical conduct in public administration.

national_news.title: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva Wins Fourth Term as President of Brazil
bullets: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won Brazil's presidential runoff election, securing 51% of the total vote to defeat Flavio Bolsonaro.
This marks an unprecedented fourth non-consecutive presidential term for Lula, making him the only politician in modern Brazilian history to achieve this milestone.
At 80 years of age, Lula becomes the oldest president to be sworn into office since Brazil restored its democracy.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Addresses Chinmaya Mission Event, Highlights '4F' Crisis in Global South
bullets: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar addressed an event marking the 75th anniversary of the Chinmaya Mission in New Delhi.
Highlighted that the Global South is currently facing a '4F' crisis comprising finance, fuel, food, and fertiliser challenges.
Reiterated zero tolerance for terrorism as an instrument of statecraft and called for reformed multilateralism at the United Nations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Introduces Performance Assessment Index for Banks
bullets: The Bihar government introduced a 100-point performance assessment index to evaluate banks operating in the state, with IDFC FIRST Bank topping the ranking with 74 points.
Banks are classified into three zones: Green Zone (11 banks scoring 50+), Yellow Zone (7 banks), and Red Zone (several banks including public sector banks).

For the Annual Credit Plan 2026-27, Bihar set a credit disbursement target of ₹4.95 lakh crore, achieving ₹1.89 lakh crore (38.25%) by 30th September 2026, with a Credit-Deposit Ratio (CDR) of 60.17%.

bihar_news.title: ICAR-MGIFRI Promotes Sustainable Orchard Management in East Champaran, Bihar
bullets: ICAR-Mahatma Gandhi Integrated Farming Research Institute (ICAR-MGIFRI), Motihari, organized a farmer awareness programme under 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan 2026' in East Champaran district.
The initiative focused on judicious fertilizer use, soil health management, nutrient recycling, crop diversification, and sustainable management of mango and litchi orchards.
Farmers were sensitized on utilizing organic resources like crop residues and farmyard manure to enhance horticultural productivity while maintaining long-term soil fertility.

bihar_news.title: Dispute Settlements Benefit Over 10,900 Bihar Gramin Bank Employees
bullets: Two industrial disputes between Bihar Gramin Bank management and employees' organizations were successfully resolved through conciliation by the Assistant Labour Commissioner (Central), Patna.
The settlements will extend financial benefits amounting to approximately ₹77.69 crore to over 10,900 employees, including recurring annual benefits of about ₹9.02 crore.

The first settlement benefits around 8,400 employees (₹67.17 crore) covering Performance Linked Incentive and wage enhancements, while the second benefits around 2,500 employees addressing the 12th Bipartite Settlement.

bihar_news.title: Bihar NEET UG 2026 Stray Round Allotment and Admission Dates Released
bullets: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) released the stray round seat allotment results for NEET UG 2026 medical and dental admissions.
Candidates participating in the Undergraduate Medical Admission Counselling (UGMAC) 2026 can download provisional allotment letters from the official website.
Document verification and reporting at assigned colleges are mandated within a strict two-day window.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranked 9th in World's 100 Best Museums List and 1st in Asia
bullets: The Bihar Museum in Patna has been ranked the 9th best museum globally by the international travel guide 'Worth a Journey'.
It stands as the only Asian museum to feature in the top 10 list, ranking even higher than New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art.
The museum showcases Bihar's history from the Stone Age to modern times through ancient sculptures, coins, manuscripts, and a dedicated children's gallery.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Seek Central Assistance for Flood-Hit Farmlands and Fisheries
bullets: The Bihar Disaster Management Department (DMD) directed District Magistrates of 22 districts to assess sand and silt deposits on agricultural land and fisheries.
Deposits were caused by severe flooding from rivers including the Ganga, Son, Gandak, and Kosi, affecting around 50 lakh people.
Financial assistance will be sought under the State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) and National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) norms to restore livelihoods.

bihar_news.title: PM Modi to Inaugurate Bhuj-Barauni Amrit Bharat Express
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is likely to inaugurate the new Amrit Bharat Express connecting Bhuj in Gujarat and Barauni in Bihar.
The 2,532-km long route spans four states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar, operating thrice a week.
The non-AC sleeper class train features affordable fares without dynamic pricing, aiding migrant workers and long-distance passengers.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Transport Department Blocks Online Services for Unpaid E-Challans
bullets: The Bihar state transport department issued directives restricting vehicle services like RC renewals, fitness certificates, and ownership transfers for vehicles with unpaid e-challans.
Vehicles with pending traffic fines can be blacklisted on the transport portal and subjected to seizure during routine checks.
The enforcement measures comply with Supreme Court directions to enhance road safety and penalize repeat traffic violators.

bihar_news.title: Strategic Relevance of India's Siang Dam Project Amid China's Yarlung Tsangpo Initiative
bullets: India's proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) in Arunachal Pradesh, valued at Rs 1.13 lakh crore, aims to counter China's massive Yarlung Tsangpo hydropower project.
The 11,200 MW project is designed for water security, flood management, and electricity generation in Northeast India.
Local indigenous communities have protested the project over concerns of land displacement, ecological damage, and loss of ancestral property.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Flags Off IndiGo's Gaya-Bangkok Non-Stop Flight
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary flagged off IndiGo's first non-stop flight from Gaya to Bangkok to boost international Buddhist pilgrimage tourism.
The twice-weekly international service coincides with the winter schedule expansion at Gaya Airport, which also includes operations by Thai Airways and Thai AirAsia.
The state government is working on a new policy to expand international aviation access and connectivity across airports in Patna, Darbhanga, Gaya, and Purnia.

bihar_news.title: PMFME Scheme Boosts Youth Entrepreneurship in Sheikhpura, Bihar
bullets: Sanjeet Barnwal, a resident of Sheikhpura, established a successful mushroom production business supported by the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) scheme.
The business supplies packaged mushrooms to Sheikhpura, neighbouring districts like Lakhisarai, Nawada, and Jamui, and markets in West Bengal.
The initiative has enabled him to achieve financial independence and create livelihood opportunities for approximately 12 local people.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Partners with IT Companies to Train Government School Teachers in AI
bullets: Bihar’s Education Department partnered with 11 IT firms, including Google Education, to provide training in artificial intelligence and digital technologies to government school teachers.
Centralised training will be conducted at the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT) campus with arrangements expected to be in place by January.
The state also plans to make computer education compulsory from Class 6 in government schools and introduce smart classrooms across 700 model schools.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Allows Ayurvedic Lecturers' Appeals Against Termination in Bihar
bullets: The Supreme Court allowed appeals by Ayurvedic lecturers against the termination of their services under the Bihar Private Medical (Indian System of Medicine) College (Taking over) Act, 1985.
The Court ruled that eligibility for absorption should be assessed based on the cutoff date of June 1, 1986, rather than the initial appointment date.
The judgment quashed previous High Court rulings and ordered the reinstatement of appellants with consequential benefits including pensions.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Education Department Issues Deadline for Science Laboratory Construction in Schools
bullets: Bihar education authorities issued show-cause notices to RailTel and Telecommunications Consultants India Ltd (TCIL) over delays in constructing science laboratories in government schools.
Out of 2,199 targeted schools under the Samagra Shiksha scheme, laboratories were completed in only 351 schools, prompting a strict deadline of November 30.
RailTel and TCIL are responsible for executing the turnkey projects across assigned districts, which include supplying physics, chemistry, and biology laboratory equipment and furniture.
